title: LastKnown
description: What the platform recorded a grid serving when it put the grid to sleep (grid-apis `sleep_record.answer_field`), carried on the `503 grid_asleep` answer to a credential-less GET of the overview. The record is kept only from a master up SLEEP_RECORD_MIN_UPTIME_SECONDS, and is deleted when somebody loses access to the grid: it must never name a machine whose owner lost access. Drift costs a stale or empty model list on a grid the reader has never seen awake — never a wake.

age_seconds.description: How old the record is, computed by the SERVER from its own clock, so no client clock matters. Never above LAST_KNOWN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS: an older record is not sent.

ids.description: Exact-case candidate model ids: a spelling source for a case map, never a list of what is served.

models.description: Lower-cased, as the overview lists them.
